name: Credit Contagion Multiplex Firm Network Dataset
alternateName: Credit Contagion and Corporate Default Risk
description: A multiplex temporal graph dataset of US public firms covering 1961-Q1 through 2026-Q1. The dataset integrates 21 source datasets from WRDS (Compustat, CRSP, TRACE, DealScan, BoardEx, Orbis), FRED, and the LoPucki Bankruptcy Research Database into 32,135 firms over 441,934 firm-years and 1,556,311 firm-quarters. The artifact is 261 quarterly PyTorch Geometric HeteroData snapshots (12.95 GB total) carrying 53 standardized firm-level features, 7 inter-firm relationship layers (supply chain, common creditor, industry 4-digit SIC, industry 3-digit SIC, geographic, ownership, board interlock — 8 HeteroData edge types after adding the supply-chain reverse edge), 2,594 default events derived from LoPucki and Compustat delisting supplements, and TRACE-derived quarterly credit spreads for 139,624 firm-quarters. Designed for research on financial-network risk transmission.
conditionsOfAccess: Mixed licensing. Code is unreleased, all rights reserved. The LoPucki-only subset of default events (data/processed/default_events_lopucki_only.parquet) and all FRED downloads (data/raw/fred/) are redistributable. All other data artifacts derived from WRDS-licensed sources (Compustat, CRSP, TRACE, DealScan, BoardEx, FactSet, Orbis) are NOT redistributable; reproducers must re-acquire them through their own WRDS subscription. See LICENSE-DATA.md for the full breakdown.

distribution.description: Source repository containing acquisition scripts, processing pipeline, documentation, and redistributable data artifacts (FRED, LoPucki). WRDS-derived parquets and graph snapshots are not included; regenerate them via the Snakefile after providing your own WRDS credentials.

variableMeasured: See docs/data_dictionary.md for the full data dictionary. Includes 53 firm-level features (leverage, profitability, liquidity, size, growth, cash flow, activity, market, macro, composite distress score, credit spread), 7 edge-layer schemas, default labels at 1q/4q/8q horizons, and quarterly credit spread targets.
